integrity: The structural reduction, enumeration and root asymptotics are explicitly supplied. The accompanying verification program uses only the Python standard library and reports bounded exhaustive checks and rational interval enclosures; no external certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Exact counts concern labeled binary periodic words, not linear words or rotation-orbits. The finite forbidden-word reduction relies on the published minimal-antisquare and exceptional bi-infinite-word results of Baranwal et al. The cyclic count is proved for all positive lengths, while brute-force checks are only finite. Gaussian limit is asymptotic, not a local limit theorem.
title: Minority-letter enumeration and Gaussian law for circular antisquare-avoiding binary words
